concepts.shortDefinition: Statutory guarantee provided by the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation, covering up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank across principal and interest across all branches of a scheduled commercial or cooperative bank.

The core financial principle establishing that a sum of money today is worth more than the identical sum in the future due to its potential earning capacity, discounting for inflation and opportunity cost.

The concessional direct tax regime under the Indian Income-tax Act 1961 featuring streamlined tax slabs with lower headline rates in exchange for forgoing most exemptions (HRA, 80C, 80D, standard housing loan interest). Default regime from FY 2023-24.

Unified grievance redressal mechanism established by the RBI in 2021 integrating ombudsman schemes for commercial banks, NBFCs, and non-bank prepaid payment instrument issuers, operating under 'One Nation One Ombudsman' with zero cost to the complainant.

Government securities denominated in grams of gold issued by the RBI on behalf of the Government of India, paying 2.50% annual interest with complete capital gains tax exemption upon maturity at 8 years under Section 47 of the Income-tax Act.
